subcategory_text: Records of data disclosures and sharing are maintained and can be accessed for review or transmission/disclosure.
informative_references: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A.5.28 (Collection of evidence), A.8.15 (Logging)
GDPR Art. 15(1)(g) (Right to access recipients), Art. 30 (Records of processing)
implementation_examples: Maintain records of all data disclosures and sharing, including recipient, date, purpose, scope, and lawful basis
Make these records accessible for review by the individual and for transmission on rights requests
Preserve records for the period required by applicable law
assessment_objectives: Determine whether disclosure and sharing records are maintained
Determine whether records include recipient, date, purpose, scope, and lawful basis
Determine whether records are accessible for individual review and rights-request fulfilment
Determine whether record retention aligns with legal minimums
